approved.en: Russia is intensifying air and missile strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure, targeting power facilities, the Northern Bridge, and emergency crews, while Ukrainian forces are hitting Russian missile launchers, air-defence systems in Bryansk Oblast and the Saratov oil refinery. Iran has delivered a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pursues a gas pipeline deal, and Azerbaijan and Ukraine have signed new energy-defence and trade agreements, with Zelensky urging Latin America to help rebuild Ukraine's power grid. Europe will join US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi, and space is becoming a critical domain in the war. 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russland intensiverer luft‑ og missilangrep mot ukrainsk infrastruktur, og rammer kraftverk, den nordlige broen og redningsmannskaper, mens ukrainske styrker treffer russiske missilutskytere og luftvernsystemer i Bryansk-oblast samt Saratov-oljeraffineriet. Iran har levert en hemmelig Khamenei-melding til Putin mens Moskva forfølger en gassrørledningsavtale, og Aserbajdsjan og Ukraina har signert nye energi-forsvars‑ og handelsavtaler, med Zelensky som oppfordrer Latin-Amerika til å hjelpe med å gjenoppbygge Ukrainas strømnett. Europa vil delta i US-medierte forhandlinger i Abu Dhabi, og rommet blir en kritisk arena i krigen. 75 767 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

A sand embankment collapsed in Gaza, killing a woman and injuring several people. Israeli forces deported fourteen foreign pro-Palestinian activists arrested in the West Bank during the olive harvest and seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens of residents. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Israel has built a 90km network of military roads across southern Lebanon, including a road in the Shebaa Valley buffer zone, and established new bases, expanding its footprint. Hezbollah continues artillery fire on Israeli positions and has begun cash payments to war victims and displaced families. Israeli strikes have wounded a Lebanese footballer and led to the detention of a 65‑year-old retired engineer. Protests against Israeli attacks on Palestine and Lebanon occurred in Sweden. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon, and there were 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Hezbollah fortsetter artilleriskudd mot israelske posisjoner og har begynt å betale kontantytelser til krigsofre og fordrevne familier. Israelske angrep har såret en libanesisk fotballspiller og ført til fengsling av en 65‑år gammel pensjonert ingeniør. Protester mot israelske angrep på Palestina og Libanon fant sted i Sverige. The IRGC announced that its self-imposed limit on ballistic-missile range has been lifted and that it is building underground sites for weapons production and storage. Tehran delivered a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pushes a gas-pipeline deal and sent a nuclear proposal to the United States via Qatar. Houthis damaged the Saudi Aramco tower in Riyadh, and 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces continue a month-long siege of Taiz while Yemeni government troops have seized the al-Jawf mountain range, intensifying front-line fighting. In Riyadh, Houthi rockets damaged the Saudi Aramco tower in the financial district and the Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi cruise missile, a long-range anti-tank guided missile and downed a ballistic missile aimed at Medina. A Saudi strike near Sanaa killed 22 civilians, mostly women and children, and a Houthi-claimed airstrike near the capital killed 22 people. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Riyadh skadet houthi-raketter Saudi Aramco-tårnet i finansdistriktet, og den saudisk-ledede koalisjonen avskjærte et houthi-kryssmissil, et langdistanse-antitank-styrt missil og skjøt ned et ballistisk missil rettet mot Medina. Et saudisk angrep nær Sanaa drepte 22 sivile, hovedsakelig kvinner og barn, og et houthi-påstått luftangrep nær hovedstaden drepte 22 personer. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Syrian forces are reported to be moving troops and advisers toward the Saudi Arabia-Yemen border, while Saudi Arabia is hosting 600 Syrian forces amid fighting with the Houthis. A Syrian sailor was killed while smuggling to the Houthis in Yemen, and a Syrian pharmaceutical tycoon was kidnapped in broad daylight in Aleppo. Israeli violations in southern Syria sparked protests, and anti-Druze hate messages have doubled after elections, spread by pro-government accounts. Syrian forces entered the Roj camp ahead of foreign repatriations, and clashes between two families in Aleppo caused deaths and injuries. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

En syrisk sjømann ble drept mens han smuglet til houthiene i Jemen, og en syrisk farmasøytisk milliardær ble kidnappet i fullt dagslys i Aleppo. Israelske overtredelser i sørlige Syria utløste protester, og hatmeldinger mot drusere har doblet seg etter valgene, spredt av pro-regjeringskontoer. Syriske styrker gikk inn i Roj-leiren før utenlandske repatrieringer, og sammenstøt mellom to familier i Aleppo førte til dødsfall og skadde. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Drone strikes attributed to Iran have halted production at the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan, cutting power output by about 2.8 gigawatts and disrupting electricity supplies in the north. Iraqi officials have asked Iran to close most border crossings, while the foreign minister is discussing militia weapons regulation with Tehran and regional security arrangements free of outside interference. Flooding in Erbil and Kirkuk has caused deaths and missing persons, and protests have blocked the Mosul-Erbil road in the Nineveh Plains, while smuggling of petroleum products was foiled in Diyala and Nineveh. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Droneangrep som tilskrives Iran har stoppet produksjonen på gassfeltet Khor Mor i irakisk Kurdistan, og redusert kraftproduksjonen med omtrent 2.8 gigawatt og forstyrret strømforsyningen i nord. Iraks tjenestemenn har bedt Iran om å stenge de fleste grenseovergangene, mens utenriksministeren diskuterer regulering av militsvåpen med Teheran og regionale sikkerhetsordninger uten utenlandsk innblanding. Flom i Erbil og Kirkuk har ført til dødsfall og savnede personer, og protester har blokkert veien Mosul-Erbil på Nineveh-sletten, mens smugling av petroleumsprodukter ble avverget i Diyala og Nineveh. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

It has arrested a former Bashir-era official and former ruling party head Ahmed Haroun, who was detained after a podcast appearance. Ethiopian fighters are being recruited into the Sudanese army and Tigrayan fighters have been drawn into the conflict, expanding the pool of combatants. The war caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Violent incidents continue across South Sudan, including a grenade explosion in Northern Bahr el Ghazal that killed four children and injured two, and the killing of an Ugandan driver in Juba that prompted transporters to demand compensation and the government to be urged to pay the victim's family. The government sent 25 young professionals to Brazil for specialized farming training and President Salva Kiir traveled to Ethiopia, while UNHCR and South Sudan officials held talks to improve support for refugees in Egypt. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Regjeringen sendte 25 unge fagfolk til Brasil for spesialisert jordbrukstrening, og president Salva Kiir reiste til Etiopia, mens UNHCR og sør-sudanske tjenestemenn holdt samtaler om å forbedre støtten til flyktninger i Egypt. UCDP registrerte to dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian military drones have entered Sudan while RSF drones are being launched from Ethiopian territory against Sudanese targets, prompting reciprocal diplomatic expulsions and consular closures. In northern Ethiopia, an RPG strike near a school in Moyale killed 60 Ethiopian Orthodox believers and a Kenyan, leading Inspector General Douglas Kanja to deploy additional police officers and hold security talks. The conflict has forced over 50,000 Ethiopian refugees to register in Kenya and has seen attacks on Orthodox Christians in Arsi, Benishangul Gumuz and the north, with blasts heard in Addis Ababa. Seed insecurity threatens Tigray farmers and psychosocial and spiritual care pilots are being tested. The war caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Etiopiske militærdroner har gått inn i Sudan mens RSF-militsens droner blir skutt fra etiopisk territorium mot sudanske mål, noe som har ført til gjensidige diplomatiske utvisninger og konsulære nedleggelser. I Nord-Etiopia drepte et RPG-angrep nær en skole i Moyale 60 etiopiske ortodokse troende og en kenyaner, noe som førte til at inspektørgeneralen Douglas Kanja sendte flere politifolk og holdt sikkerhetsmøter. Konflikten har tvunget over 50 000 etiopiske flyktninger til å registrere seg i Kenya og har medført angrep på ortodokse kristne i Arsi, Benishangul-Gumuz og i nord, med eksplosjoner hørt i Addis Ababa. Sikkerhetsmangel truer bønder i Tigray og pilotprosjekter for psykososial og åndelig omsorg blir testet. Krigen forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Supreme Court rejected President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud's term extension, prompting armed forces to seize the court and threaten the chief. Somali security forces opened fire on protesters in Mogadishu, killing at least three civilians in clashes over home demolitions and two in separate police shootings, while government troops were attacked near Leego town and al-Shabaab fighters left soldiers unburied after a deadly clash. The Somali police deputy chief warned of a security vacuum as Ugandan troops withdraw, and Egypt, Somalia and Djibouti held talks on Red Sea security and Horn of Africa stability. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den somaliske politiets nestleder advarte om et sikkerhetsvakuum når ugandiske tropper trekker seg tilbake, og Egypt, Somalia og Djibouti holdt samtaler om sikkerhet i Rødehavet og stabilitet i Afrikas horn. approved.en: IS-linked militants attacked an Ebola clinic in eastern DR Congo, forcing patients to flee and killing dozens of civilians, while ADF fighters assaulted villages in North Kivu, killing 33 residents.
